items.q: How much does a typical project cost?
items.a: It depends on the model. Product engineering (a new web app, end-to-end) runs $25K–$100K. Team augmentation is $5K–$7K per FTE per month. Shopify builds are $10K–$60K. Rescue & rewrite is $20K–$80K. We quote a fixed number once we've read the brief.

items.q: Do you work fixed-fee or time & materials?
items.a: Both. Fixed-fee when the spec is clear and the scope is bounded — most product builds and Shopify launches go this way. T&M for team augmentation and long-running operate phases where requirements keep evolving.

items.q: What's the minimum engagement you'll take on?
items.a: 0.5 FTE for team augmentation, 6 weeks for a new build, and a 60-day stabilize phase for rescues. We don't take one-off small fixes — the setup cost makes it a bad deal for both sides.

items.q: Do you take equity instead of fees?
items.a: Default is cash — we're a services studio, not an investor. That said, for the right project we'll consider a discounted rate paired with equity. It depends on stage, conviction, and contract terms. Ask.

items.q: How do you handle scope changes mid-project?
items.a: Written change request, signed estimate of impact on date and price, then we go. No silent rework, no surprise invoices.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: A new MVP runs 6–18 weeks depending on scope. Shopify launches are 6–10 weeks. Rescues start with a 60-day stabilize. Our standard 12-week picture: 2 weeks discovery, 2 weeks architecture, 6 weeks build, 1 week harden, 1 week launch.

items.q: How do you actually run a project?
items.a: Written spec with success criteria signed off before week 3. Weekly demos starting at the build phase. Staging deploys from day one. One embedded PM and tech lead — no account managers between you and the engineers.

items.q: Will I get the same team for the whole project?
items.a: Yes. The engineer who writes the code owns it. We don't rotate people on or off mid-project to free up bench capacity.

items.q: What happens after launch?
items.a: Three options: we keep operating the app on a monthly retainer (bugs, ops, small features), we hand it over to your team with documentation, or both — handover after a defined operate period. Many of our clients stay with us long after launch.

items.q: What's your stack?
items.a: TypeScript, Node.js, PHP, Python. React, Vue, Nest, Laravel, Symfony, Astro, Tailwind. PostgreSQL, MySQL, Elasticsearch. Shopify Plus, Strapi, WordPress. Docker, Cloudflare, AWS, Azure. We pick the stack to fit the problem, not the other way around.

items.q: Do you build mobile apps?
items.a: Web-first. We do responsive web apps and PWAs. For native iOS/Android we partner — we won't pretend to be a native shop.

items.q: Do you do AI features?
items.a: Yes. RAG, embedding search, LLM-powered features, agent flows, ChatGPT / Anthropic / OpenAI API integration. We've shipped AI in production for education (StudyBooster), analytics (Blaze), and heavily used it in workflow automation and researches (Crawler).

items.q: Do you do design too, or just engineering?
items.a: Engineering-led with in-house design. We don't take pure brand or logo work — we take design that supports a product build.

items.q: We have a stalled project from another vendor. Can you take it over?
items.a: Yes — that's our rescue & rewrite model. First 60 days: an honest audit, stabilize the existing code, then a fixed-scope phase to ship the actual missing parts.

items.q: Do you handle infra and DevOps?
items.a: Yes. We set up CI/CD, containerized deploys, observability and on-call playbooks as part of any product build. Cloudflare, AWS, Azure, on-prem Docker — pick what fits.

items.q: Where are you based and what timezone?
items.a: Studio HQ in Dhaka, Bangladesh (GMT+6). Working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–19:00 GMT+6, with overlap for EU, UK and Australian clients.

items.q: Do you work with US, UK, EU and Canadian clients?
items.a: Yes. We work across 10+ countries, including Australia, the UK and the US. We invoice from our Bangladesh entity, and cross-border billing is routine for us.

items.q: Who owns the code and IP?
items.a: You do. Code is delivered with full source, repository access, and IP assignment in the contract. No escrow, no lock-in.

items.q: Do you sign NDAs, MSAs and DPAs?
items.a: Yes. We have short, reasonable templates, or we'll review and sign yours.

items.q: What languages does your team speak?
items.a: English, Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian. All written work and code is in English.

items.q: How fast do you respond to a new inquiry?
items.a: Under 24 hours on business days, usually same-day.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: 7+ years running paid media and web growth, 3,500 projects delivered, and clients across 10+ countries.
